metadata.description: Formify e-signature and identity verification for AI agents

plugins.name: formify
plugins.description: Formify Core — e-signatures for any business. Build fillable PDF forms and contracts, send them for signature or publish one signing link, verify signers with BankID or an ID scan, and track what happens after sending.

plugins.name: formify-es-real-estate
plugins.description: Formify for Real Estate Agencies (Spain) — Formify Core plus the Spanish estate-agency niche: nota de encargo, buyer/seller KYC, oferta y reserva, contrato de arras, inter-agency collaboration and key handover. Bilingual, region-correct, ready to sign. Includes the full Core skill set — do not install Formify Core as well.

plugins.name: formify-tourism
plugins.description: Formify for Tourism and Rentals (EU) — Formify Core plus guest registration and vehicle hire: guest registration forms, house rules, property-manager mandates, rental agreements, handover and return records. Asks which EU country applies and follows its rules. Includes the full Core skill set — do not install Formify Core as well.

plugins.name: formify-construction
plugins.description: Formify for Construction and Renovation (EU) — Formify Core plus the documents a contractor signs: quotes, works contracts with the consumer withdrawal form, variation orders, handover records, subcontracts and payment confirmations. Asks which EU country applies and follows its rules. Includes the full Core skill set — do not install Formify Core as well.
